  POLICY NOTICE: Undeciphered.ca does NOT accept code Pull Requests.
-->

### Pull Requests & Code Contributions Are Not Accepted

Thank you for your interest in **Undeciphered.ca**!

This repository accepts **Canadian historical ciphertexts, verified keys, decoded readings, and archival corrections via GitHub Issues only**. Code contributions and Pull Requests (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, build scripts, or automated PRs) are prohibited and will be closed without review.

Please submit your cipher, key, or solve using one of our structured **GitHub Issue forms** instead:
- https://github.com/prabal-rje/undeciphered-canada/issues/new/choose

Verified submissions are credited on the cipher's timeline and on https://undeciphered.ca/contribute/ within **1 to 2 weeks**.
